Motor orders only (CPA excluded, per the org B2D rule), from glue_catalog.motor_proposal_3 with the same stage logic as Superset's "Book to Delivery Funnel". Pick an insurer, vehicle type and day — the full Booked → Issued breakdown renders as a stage list below. Rows with a ▸ arrow are clickable: they expand in place to show every real proposal_id/error/request/response Kibana has for that exact insurer/vehicle/day/stage (same underlying data as the B2D Funnel tab's cell click-through, just one insurer/day at a time). KYC and Inspection Pending/Failed share one log set (Kibana's stage field can't split them further) — same caveat as the matrix view. Booked → Delivered % by month / week / day for the selected journey, split Inspection-required vs Non-inspection-required (is_inspection_required). Motor only, CPA excluded, PDF failures count as delivered. The last ~15 days still move as inspections and post-payment steps complete.

Day-on-day Booked → Delivered % for the last 15 days, for the journey selected at the top (Combined / Old / New). Motor orders only, CPA excluded. Old journey: booked = motor order created that day, delivered = policy issued (issued / policy_pdf_generated), glue_catalog.motor_proposal_3. New journey: booked = paid order (payment succeeded, incl. later refunds), delivered = policy number issued (PDF failures count as delivered), glue_catalog.motor_new_insurance_*. Recent days are still settling: inspection cases and post-payment KYC/proposal completions keep converting for several days. The big number is the last complete day; today's point is hollow (partial day).
Table view
Day-on-day count of proposals whose current status is Proposal Failed / Proposal Retry / Proposal Retry Failed — a proposal that hit an error and then succeeded on retry is NOT counted here (checked against glue_catalog.motor_proposal_3's live status, not just "an error was logged at some point"). Defaults to All Insurers combined for the selected vehicle type; pick a specific insurer above to narrow it. Click a stage row to see error categories (from real Kibana logs, capped at ~8-day lookback for log matching — most proposals have no matching log at all, shown honestly as "(No Kibana Log)" rather than guessed); click a category to see the actual logs, each with a "Download Excel" button for sharing with an insurer's IT team.
